name: readWhenStreamIsClosed
expected: Throws IOException with message 'The stream is closed' because closed check triggers first.

name: readWhenCurrentEntryIsNull
input: Do not call getNextZipEntry(), call read(buffer, 0, 10)
expected: Returns -1 because current == null indicates no active entry.

name: readWithInvalidStartIndexNegative
expected: Throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException because start < 0 fails boundary checks.

name: readWithInvalidLengthNegative
expected: Throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException because length < 0 fails boundary checks.

name: readWithBufferOverflowBounds
input: Active entry present, buffer length = 10, start = 5, length = 10
expected: Throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException because buffer.length - start < length.

name: readStoredMethodCompletelyRead
expected: Returns -1 because all bytes of the stored entry have already been read.

name: readStoredMethodNormalRead
input: STORED entry with valid uncompressed data in buffer
expected: Copies bytes via System.arraycopy, updates CRC32, increments readBytesOfEntry and offsetInBuffer, and returns bytes read.

name: readStoredMethodEOFReached
input: STORED entry where underlying stream returns -1 on read
expected: Returns -1 indicating end of stream/entry data.

name: readDeflateMethodNeedsInputAndFills
input: DEFLATE entry where inf.needsInput() is true and fill() reads data
expected: Successfully feeds input to Inflater, inflates bytes into output buffer, updates CRC32, and returns number of bytes read.

name: readDeflateMethodFinished
input: DEFLATE entry where inf.finished() is true and inflate returns 0
expected: Returns -1 indicating the end of the compressed entry data.

name: readDeflateMethodTruncatedZip
input: DEFLATE entry where inflate returns 0, inf.finished() is false, and lengthOfLastRead is -1
expected: Throws IOException with message 'Truncated ZIP file'.

name: readDeflateMethodDataFormatException
input: DEFLATE entry where inf.inflate throws DataFormatException
expected: Catches DataFormatException and throws ZipException wrapping the message.

name: readStoredMethodTruncatedEntrySizeLimit
input: STORED entry where remaining csize (csize - readBytesOfEntry) is less than requested toRead
expected: Clips toRead to remaining entry size and returns that number of bytes.
